assets.purpose: Compare diagram: What each validation option uses (wide layout).
assets.license: Original diagram authored for this course; no third-party elements
assets.alt: A comparison of validation options and the data each uses. A tailored demo uses a prepared scenario or uploaded customer files, with no connectors. A sandbox uses uploaded files for an allotted group of users, with no connectors. A pilot connects to the customer's systems for a defined cohort.
